projects.name: ready-set-co-op
projects.title: ready SET Co-op
projects.description: Proposed sustainable employment and training cooperative connecting local skills, shared equipment, media, community services and locally governed digital capability on Minjerribah. The Cloudflare site is its public participation doorway; cooperative formation and project handovers remain subject to member decisions.

lifecycle.note: Umbrella initiative. The Trust Hub, hyperlocal media, cultural intelligence node and noticeboard are related projects, not separate versions of the entire cooperative. Original build date not independently verified.
